title: Americans' social activity has steeply declined in the past 30 years
summary: This research article from Data for Progress examines the significant decline in Americans' social activity and community engagement over the past three decades, presenting data-driven insights into social isolation trends and their implications for society.
problem_solved: Documents and quantifies the documented decline in Americans' social connectivity and community participation.
why_valuable: Provides actionable data for policymakers and researchers to understand and address the growing social isolation crisis affecting public health and community well-being.
